name: Motor Bicycle
description: A bicycle with a seat to which a power unit that isn't an integral part of the vehicle has been added, letting it travel no faster than 30 mph with a 150-pound rider; a bicycle fitted with an electric conversion kit outside the e-bike limits lands here. Defined by Wisconsin Statutes §340.01(30).

restrictions.rule: A bicycle with a seat and an added power unit that isn't part of the original vehicle
Travels no faster than 30 mph with a 150-pound rider on a dry, level, hard surface with no wind
Not an electric bicycle or a moped
Riders need a valid operator's license, or a special restricted or restricted license
Ridden under the rules for bicycles, except the crosswalk rules
Not allowed on a bicycle way with the power unit running
Exempt from state registration, though a municipality may require local registration
